content: If also doing the INDX conversion, the guide states the bowden guide isn't used any longer so I removed the nut. (Push the end of a zip tie through the screw hole to slide the nut out a little, then grab the nut with needle nose pliers to remove.)
Isn't that an M3nS nut?  Not M3nN?
Please add that you need to cut the excess portion of the zip tie.
